title: Mask Adoption Diffusion Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population under social influence, policy interventions, media messaging, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: People observe mask use and opinions among their social neighbors and update attitudes and behaviors via conformity, trust, and susceptibility parameters.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations and government agents enforce mandates; non-compliant persons may be denied entry, fined, or reminded, affecting future compliance.

interactions.name: mask_acquisition
interactions.description: Persons purchase or obtain masks from retailers subject to inventory and price; access constraints influence adoption.

interactions.name: media_influence
interactions.description: Media messages (including misinformation) affect risk perception and attitudes toward masks.

interactions.name: location_interaction
interactions.description: Persons interact at locations (home, work, public spaces) where mask requirements may be in effect; interactions update perceived norms.

interactions.name: feedback_from_outcomes
interactions.description: Observed outcomes (e.g., perceived safety, social approval, access to services) feed back into personal risk perception and future mask-use decisions.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of people wearing masks each day.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until at least 50% of the population consistently wears masks.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum observed adoption rate during the simulation.

metrics.name: endline_adoption
metrics.description: Adoption rate at the end of the simulation period, indicating persistence.

metrics.name: policy_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Share of visits to locations with mandates where persons comply with mask rules.

metrics.name: access_inequality_index
metrics.description: Inequality in access to masks across socioeconomic groups (e.g., Gini of mask possession).

metrics.name: sentiment_polarization
metrics.description: Degree of polarization in attitudes toward masks across the social network.

metrics.name: purchase_backlog
metrics.description: Unmet demand measured as attempted purchases when inventory is zero.
